capabilities: Edit .mdx files with Obsidian's native editor, Live Preview and frontmatter
Preview JSX components in a sandboxed pane with no vault or network access
Render wikilinks, embeds, GFM, code highlighting and Mermaid diagrams in .mdx files
Compile and load custom components from a vault .tsx/.jsx file or pre-built bundle
Print or save previews as PDF on desktop
extras: First preview open requires a one-time-per-session trust confirmation because .mdx files can contain real JavaScript; full note transclusion and import/export statements in .mdx are not supported.
problem: Obsidian treats .mdx files as plain text and its Reading Mode only shows raw code for JSX components, so there is no way to preview Markdown with interactive React components in the vault.
summary: MDX file support that opens .mdx notes in the native editor and renders embedded JSX components in a sandboxed preview pane.
